learning_goal.en: Turn the slice width into a square area before integrating along x.

notes.en: A solid’s volume accumulates cross-sectional area, not just the base width.
notes.ko: 입체의 부피는 밑면의 폭만이 아니라 단면의 넓이를 누적합니다.

alt_text.en: Volumes from cross sections. A solid’s volume accumulates cross-sectional area, not just the base width.

notes.en: Perpendicular to the x-axis, each cross section is a square whose side spans the base.
notes.ko: x축에 수직인 각 단면은 밑면을 가로지르는 선분을 한 변으로 하는 정사각형입니다.

notes.en: Turn the slice width into a square area before integrating along x.

notes.en: Square the full side length, including both terms.

alt_text.en: Step 1  Set it up. Square the full side length, including both terms.

alt_text.en: Step 2  Work carefully. Expanding the square makes termwise integration straightforward.

notes.en: The result uses cubic units because area was accumulated along a length.
notes.ko: 넓이를 길이 방향으로 누적했으므로 결과는 부피 단위입니다.

notes.en: Find the volume for semicircular cross sections.

alt_text.en: Your turn. Find the volume for semicircular cross sections.
alt_text.ko: 직접 풀어보세요. 반원 단면의 부피를 구하세요.

prompt.en: Find the volume for semicircular cross sections.

answer.en: π/3. A=π(2−x)²/8 because the radius is half the diameter; integrate from 0 to 2.
answer.ko: π/3입니다. 반지름은 지름의 절반이므로 A=π(2−x)²/8을 0부터 2까지 적분합니다.

caption.en:
AP Calculus AB • L58
Volumes from cross sections

A solid’s volume accumulates cross-sectional area, not just the base width.
Turn the slice width into a square area before integrating along x.

1. Square the full side length, including both terms.
2. Expanding the square makes termwise integration straightforward.
3. The result uses cubic units because area was accumulated along a length.

Remember: The specified cross-sectional shape determines A(x); a width alone is not an area.

CHECK ANSWER — try card 8 first
π/3. A=π(2−x)²/8 because the radius is half the diameter; integrate from 0 to 2.
